blocks.text: Today, as her almost completely sold-out headlining North American tour takes off, rising pop phenom Alyssa Grace releases her highly anticipated single “washing skin,” out now on Artist House. As vulnerable as anything she’s shared so far, the new song finds the singer, songwriter, and guitarist driving straight into past traumas to reclaim her truth. Listen HERE. “washing skin” might be Alyssa’s biggest sounding song yet, combining soaring cinematic instrumentation with her signature emotional rawness. She layers her voice until it becomes an angelic choir that ushers in her up-close acoustic storytelling. The diaristic details then spill out as the track […]...
